text:
Sasha: Heads-up — Brightwater private rollout is on our calendar for next Tue. Quick sync: last-mile networking, cert handoff, and airgap image sync are still fuzzy for them. Who can own final network signoff?
Matt: I can take network signoff but need "+egress e2e+" confirmation from infra. Will validate NAT+SNAT rules Thursday. :thumbsup:
Prashant: I still need the customer egress IP list, Brightwater said they'll send by EOD today. Without that we can't test their firewall rules.
Karen: I have the KMS/HSM integration checklist for Private. Brightwater asked about bringing their HSM — do we have a contact to validate compatibility? @Sasha?
Sasha: Yes — contact is Omar@brightwater. I'll DM him. On HSM compatibility: we support PKCS#11 flow but need to confirm cert formats.
Lina: On airgap image sync: staging artifacts are ready in the registry, but the image signing key hasn't been rotated. I pushed PR #3821 to rotate and update the import script. Can someone review?
Alice: I'll review PR #3821 now. Quick note: the image import tool expects gz archives named <tenant>-images.tar.gz (docs gap). I'll add a small note in the runbook.
devops-bot: [checklist] connectivity-check: pending -> egress IPs missing; certs: pending -> customer action required; image-sync: blocked -> key rotation PR pending review.
Matt: For canary, I propose a 2-node onprem canary with fallback to hosted model if latency > 150ms. Can Ops allocate burst capacity? @Prashant
Prashant: Ops can allocate burst for first 6 hours of the launch window. Need the exact instance types and expected qps.
Sasha: Expected qps ~ 5 rps sustained, peaks ~ 25 rps for a short period. Instance types: g5.large-ish equivalent, we'll confirm in deployment doc.
Karen: Security asks: audit logging needs to be enabled and logs pushed to their SIEM over secure channel. Have we confirmed S3-bucket cross-account or SFTP?
Lina: Brightwater prefers SFTP pull. I'll draft the SFTP key exchange steps and add to runbook.
Alice: PR review done, left one comment about error handling in the import script.
Sasha: Awesome. Action items roundup: (1) Prashant — request Brightwater egress IPs and confirm burst capacity (2) Matt — validate NAT/SNAT + smoke tests on Thu (3) Lina — draft SFTP key-exchange + runbook update (4) Karen — verify HSM contact + audit log transfer method (5) Alice — merge PR after addressing comment. I'll follow up with Omar on cert format.
Matt: Also tagging @oncall for the deployment window: propose 09:00-12:00 PT on Tue. Can oncall be present for first 2 hours?
devops-bot: Reminder scheduled: oncall rota ping will go out 24h before.
Prashant: I'll post when I get the egress IPs. If they don't send by EOD, we should gate the rollout.
Sasha: Agreed. If no IPs by EOD Friday, we pivot to dry-run only next week and reschedule cutover.
Karen: Noted. Thanks all. :eyes:
Matt: small note — adding a quick smoke command for Friday:
```
# run from staging bastion
curl -v --resolve api.brightwater.private:443:<egress_ip> https://api.brightwater.private/healthz
```
Lina: nice, will add to runbook.
Alice: closing loop on PR after fix, ETA ~2h.
Sasha: Thanks team — will update this thread after I hear from Omar. If anyone hits blockers, ping here.
